label: AI REFERENCE ENDPOINT CONTROL; STUDENT DID NOT SELECT A GOAL

protocol.type: AI known-input endpoint control after student uncertainty
protocol.controls: Use exact archived obstacle rows, not regeneration with a different endpoint. Start/world/body/margin/contact/policies fixed; only chosen goal changes. Point cells of G/A/B already free; do not remove any walls. Preserve original source and all three variants.
protocol.aiPriorKnowledge: Endpoint-validity expectations come from the archived configuration mask. No expected route length/count or guaranteed route toA is asserted before execution. Valid endpoint and graph reachability are separate.
protocol.budgetScope: 100 per stage; direct fine cap100 versus quality-checked cap200, not equal total-budget performance comparison.
protocol.validation: Bind unchanged validated policy/core/body/reference source hashes and prior101-test record without a full-suite repeat. Commit new protocol/runner/uncertainty before controls. Check exact original obstacle rows/masks, separate endpoint-gated BFS, original-world path segments, stage costs, originalG reproduction, point-to-square goal clearance and output no-overwrite guard.
protocol.attribution: Student said 몰라 and chose no goal. AI supplies A reference answer, protocol/options/source/operation/analysis. No student endpoint-design or independent discovery inferred.
protocol.scope: One archived map, three endpoint assignments, six policy evaluations, not three new maps or an independent cohort. Moving a goal changes the problem, not the planning algorithm. No physical movement, controller, sensor, safety, timing or energy measurement.
